svg.text: The data engineer / analyst handoff — where the line sits and how it is crossed

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The handoff is not a person taking over. It is a governed object plus a grant. The DE keeps owning the supply.

svg.text: How the analyst actually reaches your metric view — the handoff is three things

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The metric view (and gold tables) ARE the

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: interface. The analyst never sees your

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: notebooks, pipelines or silver mess — only

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the clean, named objects you expose.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: You run GRANT in Unity Catalog. Until you do,

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the analyst cannot see the object at all. This

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is the literal moment of handoff — and it is

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The analyst finds it in Catalog Explorer by

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: name, reads its description, measures and

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: synonyms, and queries it — in a dashboard,

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in Genie, or from Power BI / Tableau.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: -- let the analyst group into the catalog and schema

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG retail_q TO analysts;

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: GRANT USE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA retail_q.retail_semantic

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: -- let them read the metric view (not the raw tables)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grant the VIEW, withhold the tables

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: You can grant SELECT on the metric view WITHOUT granting

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it on fact_sales or silver. The analyst then gets governed

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: metrics only — never the raw, un-modelled tables.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: That is the point of the layer: it is both a definition

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AND a controlled surface. One revenue number, exposed on

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: semantic layer — sitting exactly on the

svg.text: The key point: you do NOT hand off and walk away

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The analyst consumes the metric view. You keep owning the SUPPLY behind it: the pipeline running on schedule (section 13),

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the data staying fresh and correct, schema changes not breaking downstream, the SLA. Consumption is handed off; the plumbing is not.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The metric view is the contract between the two of you — stable on their side, maintained on yours.
